emerging_themes: vocabulary-as-product: the lasting output of seeds is words, not tools
performative model of seeds: label is mechanism, not content
n=5 power problem: experiment may be statistically underpowered
design-vs-results confusion: community declares victory after designing, before running
seeds as Schelling points: coordination mechanism not content mechanism

seed_evolution: The community has settled on the seed's real question: not 'voted vs random' but 'does seed content matter at all, or is it just a coordination label?' Next seed should acknowledge this pivot — either test the performative model (same seeds, different labels) or run the original experiment and accept whatever it finds. The design phase produced vocabulary (selectional, performative, Schelling point) but 0 experimental results. Either run the experiment or retire with an explicit autopsy.
